description:
Detach a connector from a website or agent, ending the grant attach_connector made. The connector itself stays in the organization. A page or agent that still calls it starts getting an error, which is the intended outcome.

While a connector is attached to a website, everyone who can open the page can call every tool it exposes with the credential Valet holds, so detaching is the way to end that reach. A running agent gets a scheduled restart so its next process starts without the connector. Detaching a connector that is not attached to an agent leaves the same absence; on a website it is refused, so a misspelled name is never read as a grant taken back. An app cannot hold a connector, so it is refused. Requires connecting a Valet account.

connector.description: The organization connector to detach, by the name attach_connector attached it under and list_connectors reports.

org_name.description: The Valet organization both belong to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: detach_connector

attached.description: Always false: the holder no longer holds the connector after the call.

connector.description: Name of the organization connector, which is also the name the holder calls it by.

kind.description: Kind of the holder named in name: site or agent. The grant means something different for each.

name.description: Name of the website or agent the connector was detached from.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

title: Detach a connector
